about: A sigil classifies a leading-segment positional by prefix, strips that prefix from its value, and leaves the ordinary positional cursor untouched.

vectors.doc: Several classified values may surround flags before the first ordinary positional.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
flag "--quiet"
arg "[tools]..." sigil="+"
arg "<command>"
arg "[args]..."

vectors.doc: After an explicit separator the same prefix is ordinary data.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
arg "[tools]..." sigil="+"
arg "<command>"
arg "[args]..."

vectors.doc: A bare classifier is an empty sigil value, not ordinary positional data.
A detached flag value owns the next token before sigil classification runs.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
flag "--label <label>"
arg "[tools]..." sigil="+"
arg "<command>"

vectors.doc: A classified positional before a known subcommand does not make the subcommand an ordinary value.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
arg "[tools]..." sigil="+"
cmd "build" { arg "<target>" }

vectors.doc: A classified value may follow an ordinary positional while flag parsing remains active.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
arg "[tools]..." sigil="+"
arg "<command>"
arg "[args]..."

vectors.doc: A sigil declared by an ancestor remains in scope after an explicit subcommand or alias.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
arg "[tools]..." sigil="+"
cmd "build" { alias "b"; arg "<target>" }

vectors.doc: A sigil does not prevent a later ordinary word from selecting the default subcommand.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
default_subcommand "run"
arg "[tools]..." sigil="+"
cmd "run" { arg "<command>" }

vectors.doc: A declared sigil binds before an external-command catch-all forwards the remaining argv.
Once an automatic trailing positional starts, later sigil-shaped words are data.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
arg "[tools]..." sigil="+"
arg "<command>" double_dash="automatic"
arg "[args]..."
